# intutic_members (Data Source)

Every member of the workspace, deactivated ones included (`GET /api/v1/members`). Filter with a `for` expression, for example on `is_active` or `role`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "intutic_members" "all" {}

locals {
  admins = [for m in data.intutic_members.all.members : m.email if m.is_active && contains(["OWNER", "ADMIN"], m.role)]
}
```
